items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued November 3 at 12:33PM EST until November 4 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Tallahassee FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Bay County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 3 at 3:11PM EST until November 3 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Tallahassee FL
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Mexico Beach to Okaloosa Walton
County Line FL out 20 NM, Coastal waters from Mexico Beach to
Apalachicola FL out 20 NM and Coastal Waters From Ochlockonee
River to Apalachicola Fl out to 20 Nm.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM EST /6 PM CST/ this evening.

* IMPACTS...A Small Craft Advisory means that wind speeds of 20
to 33 knots, or seas of 7 feet or greater, are expected to
produce hazardous conditions for small craft. These hazardous
conditions may result in poor vessel handling and steering
response, broaching, overturned dinghies and kayaks, slips and
falls on slippery decks, rub damage along docks and seawalls,
and dragging anchors.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
